title: THE PURPOSE OF THIS AWARD IS TO CONDUCT RESEARCH ON AMPLIFICATION ASSAYS IN WILD CERVIDS AND OTHER NEW TEST METHODS. ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED INCLUDE…
description: THE PURPOSE OF THIS AWARD IS TO CONDUCT RESEARCH ON AMPLIFICATION ASSAYS IN WILD CERVIDS AND OTHER NEW TEST METHODS. ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED INCLUDE DEVELOPMENT OF CRISPR-ELISA AMPLIFICATION ASSAY (CLISA) FOR THE DETECTION OF CWD AS OUTLINED IN PRIORITY AREA #3, WE PROPOSE TO DEVELOP A CRISPR BASED ELISA AMPLIFICATION ASSAY (CLISA) FOR DETECTION OF CWD FROM SAMPLES. ASSAY CONDITIONS WILL BE OPTIMIZED, AND SENSITIVITY AND SPECIFICITY OF THE ASSAY WILL BE DETERMINED.; TESTING OF DIFFERENT SAMPLE TYPES WITH CLISA DIFFERENT SAMPLE TYPES SUCH AS OBEX, RETROPHARYNGEAL LYMPH NODES, AND OTHER SAMPLES INCLUDING NASAL SWABS AND FECES AS AVAILABLE FROM HUNTER-KILLED DEER WILL BE TESTED BY THIS NEWLY DEVELOPED AMPLIFICATION ASSAY. THE AIM IS TO BE ABLE TO DETECT CWD RAPIDLY IN SAMPLES COLLECTED FROM WILD CERVIDS. FOR THIS, SAMPLES WILL BE SPIKED WITH RECOMBINANT PRPC AND PROCESSED USING STANDARD METHODS; COMPARISON OF CLISA WITH ELISA USING CLINICAL SAMPLES PERFORMANCE OF NOVEL AMPLIFICATION METHOD (CLISA) WILL BE COMPARED WITH ELISA (BIO-RAD). THIS METHOD IS CURRENTLY BEING USED IN OUR LAB AT THE AVDL TO TEST SAMPLES FOR CWD. SAMPLES RECEIVED AT THE AVDL FOR SURVEILLANCE TES TING FROM CLIENTS INCLUDING GEORGIA DEPARTMENT OF NATURAL RESOURCES, AND SAMPLES RECEIVED AT THE UMN VDL (MINNESOTA IS A CWD POSITIVE STATE) WILL BE TESTED BY BOTH THE METHODS SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF THIS PROJECT WILL LEAD TO DEVELOPMENT OF A NOVEL AMPLIFICATION ASSAY WHICH HARNESSES THE POWER OF CRISPR…

description: 1. AWARD PURPOSE: THE PRIMARY PURPOSE OF THIS AGREEMENT IS TO SUPPORT THE MASS PRODUCTION, DISTRIBUTION, AND EVALUATION OF LILIOCERIS EGENA A NEW BIOLOGICAL CONTROL AGENT OF AIR POTATO. THE COOPERATOR PROPOSES TO INCREASE THE BEETLE LABORATORY REARING CAPACITY, RELEASE AND ESTABLISH THROUGHOUT THE INVADED RANGE, MONITOR AND EXAMINE THEIR IMPACT AND SAFETY ON THE TARGET WEED. THE OVERALL GOAL IS A REDUCTION IN THE COMPETITIVENESS OF AIR POTATO IN AGRICULTURAL AND NATURAL ENVIRONMENTS. 2. ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED: THE COOPERATOR WILL MAINTAIN LABORATORY COLONIES OF THE AIR POTATO BIOLOGICAL CONTROL AGENT, L. EGENA; DEVELOP METHODS TO OPTIMIZE L. EGENA NON-QUARANTINE COLONY PRODUCTION; INVESTIGATE METHODS FOR MOST EFFICIENTLY CONDUCTING FIELD RELEASES OF L. EGENA; DETERMINE WHETHER L. EGENA WILL OVIPOSIT ON BULBILS ON THE VINE, OR ONLY POST-DEHISCENT BULBILS; MONITOR FOR ESTABLISHMENT OF PERSISTENT L. EGENA POPULATIONS WITHIN RELEASE SITES, DISPERSAL WITHIN RELEASE SITES, AND DISPERSAL FROM RELEASE SITES TO NEIGHBORING POPULATIONS OF AIR POTATO VINE; AND TEST WHETHER COMMON MOSQUITO PESTICIDES WILL BE AS TOXIC TO L. EGENA AS THEY ARE TO L. CHENI. 3. DELIVERABLES AND EXPECTED OUTCOMES: BIOLOGICAL CONTROL IS THE SAFEST AND MOST SUSTAINABLE METHOD FOR CONTROLLING LANDSCAPE SCALE INVASIVE WEEDS.
